result_preview.description: This agent continuously analyzes CustomerSegment performance data and engagement metrics to recommend real-time campaign optimizations. It evaluates segment characteristics against Campaign performance indicators, automatically adjusts audience targeting parameters, and generates personalized messaging recommendations. The agent reduces manual campaign tuning effort while improving conversion rates through data-driven segment-to-campaign alignment.

result_preview.description: This agent monitors campaign performance across customer segments and automatically refines audience targeting strategies based on real-time engagement metrics. It coordinates segmentation updates, evaluates account-level campaign receptiveness, and processes customer behavioral patterns to continuously enhance campaign ROI and relevance. The agent leverages AI-driven analysis to recommend and execute audience refinements that align campaigns with high-value customer accounts.
